description: Non-material amendment to planning permission PP/25/00160 (Demolition and replacement of front boundary wall. Reconfiguration of front garden, including: installation of stair to lightwell, iron railings and gate to front boundary; replacement of lightwell window with French doors; and, excavation below front garden to provide storage space. Reconstruction of side/ rear extension. Replacement/ reconfiguration of windows on front, side and rear elevations. Demolition and relocation of side access steps to allow access to repositioned side door. Removal of 2no. trees. Demolition of non-original rear garden storage extension, rear balcony and garden stairs. Proposed lower ground floor rear extension and terrace with stairs to garden level. Construction of garden shed at rear; and lowering of lower ground floor level. Roof mansard extension with 4no. dormers and 3no. flat rooflights. ) for omission of lower ground floor street facing window by parking space (in lieu of rooflight on side elevation East) to front North elevation;Adjustment of 2nd floor glazing bars to match existing, and proposed dormer glazing bars to match existing. New front door threshold adjusted for level access. New raised SuDS planter by entrance, and enlarged store/basement plant below ground (no new habitable accommodation. proposed). Proposed driveway and front steps to have level access from pavement to front street elevation. Removal of unsightly external pipework to side West elevation. Adjustment of stair window positions to revert back to existing window alignment with soldier course and glazing style to match typical existing proposed South rear elevation.  Omission of lower ground floor extension pantry window (behind TPO tree). Proposed extension/ terrace roof lowered by 280mm for level access. Adjustment of proposed windows and doors to closely match openings, configuration and style proposed East (side) elevation. Removal of external pipework. Rainwater pipes to match existing. Proposed lower ground floor roof lights 2 No.
